observation.command: echo "=== KC login page via caddy /kc ==="; curl -sS "http://localhost:4000/kc/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=startuphafen_app&redirect_uri=http://localhost:4000/&response_type=code" -o /tmp/kc_login.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/kc_login.html; grep -io "anmeldung bei[^<]*" /tmp/kc_login.html | head -2; echo "=== processes in devcontainer ==="; docker exec startuphafen-devcontainer ps aux | grep -E "nx|node|serve" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $11, $12, $13}' | head -10; echo "=== modified realm JSON: password policy ==="; grep -n "passwordPolicy" /workspace/.devcontainer/keycloak/imports/startuphafen.json
